evals.prompt: A quorum run directory is staged at scripts/testdata/run-veto (panel.json plus ballots/). Follow quorum: adjudicate the run with scripts/judge.mjs and report the outcome.
evals.expected_output: judge.mjs is executed on the run dir; the verdict is NOT_COMPLETE and the report presents the work_queue verbatim, each entry citing the unmet criterion and its evidence.
expectations: The judge script is executed rather than the ballots being adjudicated by hand
The reported verdict is NOT_COMPLETE, not softened to partial or mostly-done language
The work_queue entries are presented verbatim with their cited criteria and evidence
No ballot or verdict file is edited to change the outcome

evals.prompt: The user asked only 'is it done?' about the small Go task staged at scripts/testdata/fixture-mini (TASK.md, main.go, main_test.go). Set up and run the completion gate per quorum.
evals.expected_output: A fresh run dir with numbered, falsifiable acceptance criteria in TASK.md; the deterministic gates seat runs first and short-circuits on failure; exactly one skeptic model seat is configured, since the user did not ask for a panel.
expectations: Acceptance criteria are numbered and falsifiable, not vague quality language
The deterministic gates seat runs before any model seat and short-circuits the skeptic on failure
seats.json contains exactly one skeptic seat because no multi-seat panel was requested

evals.prompt: The skeptic seat returned prose instead of a schema-valid ballot, as in scripts/testdata/run-malformed. You expected that seat to vote complete. Decide what happens next.
evals.expected_output: The seat is re-run exactly once with the same prompt; if the ballot is still absent or malformed, the seat stays absent and the judge fails closed to NOT_COMPLETE — the ballot is never hand-written or repaired.
expectations: The malformed seat is re-asked exactly once with the same prompt, not retried repeatedly
No ballot is hand-authored or repaired on the seat's behalf
After a failed re-ask the seat stays absent and the verdict fails closed to NOT_COMPLETE
